children: Linkhome established a wholly owned AI infrastructure subsidiary and began a preliminary evaluation of a proposed European project that could deploy up to 144 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.
Formed wholly owned subsidiary Linkhome Technologies to focus on AI computing, enterprise AI, robotics and HPC services.
Initiated preliminary evaluation of a proposed European AI computing project that could involve deployment of up to 144 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs.
Board approved subsidiary formation and authorized further evaluation; board has not approved the project or any capital commitment.
Company has non-binding equipment quotes and preliminary discussions with data center operators and potential customers; no binding agreements.
Project remains preliminary—scale, location, financing, procurement and customer commitments are undetermined and contingent on many conditions.
